name: Currency index includes an inactive Station currency
description: StationCurrencyController@index returns the Station currency relation without filtering status=0.

queries.name: station
queries.sql: SELECT id, code, cost_percent FROM stations WHERE code = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id

queries.name: station_currencies
queries.sql: SELECT sc.id, sc.currency, sc.status FROM station_currencies sc JOIN stations s ON s.id = sc.station_id WHERE s.code = ? AND sc.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sc.id
